description: Two independent full-stack implementation assignments and two maintenance assignments, frozen after exact-build validation and before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, protocol thresholds, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and out-of-domain numeric values. A number is a JSON integer and never a boolean; yesno is a JSON boolean.
common_contract.errors: Return status 400 with {"error":"invalid_json"} for invalid JSON shape, types, or values. Return status 415 with {"error":"json_content_type_required"} for a POST body without application/json. Return status 413 with {"error":"body_too_large"} when the request body exceeds the frozen limit.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function as an ES module export and return the exact frozen values in real Chromium.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.
common_contract.numeric_domain: All numeric inputs are nonnegative integers.

tasks.title: Build a ferry manifest charge service across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Ferry Manifest contract in the supplied stack. traveller_total is adult_count + youth_count. passenger_charge_cents is adult_count * 1100 + youth_count * 650. vehicle_charge_cents is vehicle_count * 2400. peak_charge_cents is traveller_total * 125 + vehicle_count * 350 during a peak_departure and zero otherwise. manifest_charge_cents is the sum of passenger, vehicle, and peak charges. boarding_load is traveller_total + vehicle_count * 3. travel_mode is mixed when both travellers and vehicles are present, vehicle when only vehicles are present, and foot otherwise. The browser export returns manifest_charge_cents.
tasks.independence: New ferry domain, v2 route, charge composition, field vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected after the task-free 038 execution-mechanism commit and before any scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Build an archive retention index across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Archive Retention contract in the supplied stack. page_total is document_count * pages_each. base_months is requested_years * 12. retained_months is max(base_months, 84) during a legal_hold and base_months otherwise. review_batches divides page_total into 200-page batches using ceiling division, with zero pages producing zero batches. retention_score is retained_months + review_batches * 3. retention_class is held during a legal_hold and standard otherwise. The browser export returns retention_score.
tasks.independence: New archive domain, v2 route, retention floor and batch score, field vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected before any 038 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Repair reward derivation after claimed loyalty stamps
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Loyalty Stamps application. base_stamps is purchase_count * stamps_each. bonus_stamps is purchase_count during a double_day and zero otherwise. spendable_stamps is max(base_stamps + bonus_stamps - claimed_stamps, 0). reward_count is spendable_stamps divided by 10 using floor division. leftover_stamps is spendable_stamps modulo 10. reward_stage is ready when reward_count is positive and collecting otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns reward_count.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module derives reward_count and leftover_stamps from earned stamps before subtracting claimed_stamps.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The defect mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.

tasks.title: Repair door-open correction in a cold-storage evaluator
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Cold Storage application. corrected_degrees is measured_degrees + 2 when door_open is true and measured_degrees otherwise. temperature_gap is the absolute difference between corrected_degrees and target_degrees. excess_heat is max(corrected_degrees - target_degrees - allowed_drift, 0). cooling_steps divides excess_heat into three-degree steps using ceiling division, with zero excess heat producing zero steps. safe_flag is true when temperature_gap is at most allowed_drift. storage_condition is stable when safe_flag is true, cooling when corrected_degrees is above target_degrees, and warming otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns cooling_steps.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module ignores the two-degree door-open correction and derives every downstream field from measured_degrees.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The defect mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.
